info.name: Unisole Engine
info.description:
REST API for the Unisole LMS (Express + Drizzle + PostgreSQL).

Base URL is controlled by the {{baseUrl}} variable (see the 'unisole' environment).

Rules:
- Create returns 201, delete returns 204 (no body)
- List endpoints return JSON arrays; get/update return a single object
- Required fields are marked in each request body
- Foreign keys (course_id, module_id, user_id, ...) must be real UUIDs - copy them from a list response
- Errors return { "error": "<message>" } with 400 / 404 / 500

request.description: Returns {"status":"ok"} when the API is up.
Set {{userId}} to a UUID from 'List users'.
Required: name, email. Returns 201.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{categoryId}} to a UUID from 'List categories'.
Required: name. Returns 201.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{courseId}} to a UUID from 'List courses'.
Modules of the course, each with its lessons.
The course with nested modules and lessons.
Required: title, slug. category_id is optional - paste a real category UUID or remove it.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body). Cascades to the course's modules.
Set {{moduleId}} to a UUID from 'List modules'.
Content items ordered within the module.
Required: title. course_id is optional - paste a real course UUID or remove it.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{moduleItemId}} to a UUID from 'List module items'.
Required: title, type. type is one of: video, pdf, article, quiz, assignment.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{moduleLessonId}} to a UUID from 'List module lessons'.
Required: module_id, module_item_id. Paste real UUIDs from the module and module item list responses.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{assignmentId}} to a UUID from 'List assignments'.
Required: title. lesson_id is optional - paste a real module item UUID or remove it.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{submissionId}} to a UUID from 'List assignment submissions'.
Required: assignment_id, user_id. Paste real UUIDs from the assignment and user list responses.
Partial update. status is one of: pending, graded.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{quizId}} to a UUID from 'List quizzes'.
Required: title. moduel_item_id is optional - paste a real module item UUID or remove it.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{testId}} to a UUID from 'List tests'.
Required: title. module_item_id is optional.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body). Cascades to attempts.
Set {{questionId}} to a UUID from 'List questions'.

body.raw:
{
  "quiz_id": "{{quizId}}",
  "question_text": "What is a type alias?",
  "type": "mcq_single",
  "options": ["A name for a type", "A CSS class", "A variable", "An import"],
  "correct_answer": ["A name for a type"],
  "marks": 5
}

request.description: Required: quiz_id, question_text, type. type is one of: mcq_single, mcq_multi, true_false, subjective. Paste a real quiz UUID.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{attemptId}} to a UUID from 'List test attempts'.
Required: test_id, user_id. Paste real UUIDs from the test and user list responses.
Partial update. status is one of: in_progress, submitted, evaluated.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{cartId}} to a UUID from 'List carts'.
Required: user_id. A user can only have one cart.
Only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{couponId}} to a UUID from 'List coupons'.
Required: code, discount_type (flat or percent).
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{enrollmentId}} to a UUID from 'List enrollments'.
Required: user_id, course_id. Unique per (user, course) pair.
Partial update. status is one of: active, completed, expired.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{orderId}} to a UUID from 'List orders'.
Required: user_id. coupon_id is optional.
Partial update. status is one of: created, paid, failed, refunded.
Returns 204 (no body). Cascades to order items and payments.
Set {{orderItemId}} to a UUID from 'List order items'.
Required: order_id, course_id.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{paymentId}} to a UUID from 'List payments'.
Required: order_id. status is one of: captured, failed, refunded.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{certificateId}} to a UUID from 'List certificates'.
Required: user_id, course_id. Unique per (user, course) pair.
Partial update - only include the fields to change.
Returns 204 (no body).
Set {{reviewId}} to a UUID from 'List reviews'.
Required: user_id, course_id, rating (1-5). Unique per (user, course) pair.
Partial update. rating must stay between 1 and 5.
Returns 204 (no body).
